summary.text: MIKO HOLDING AS is a private limited company registered in Søgne, founded 1997-01-17. MIKO HOLDING AS is registered for investment activities and everything related to them. The company may also engage in leasing of operating equipment and provide consulting services. It was previously named ABI HOLDING AS until 2008-04-16. Its main industry code is 71.121: civil engineering activities. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 1 000 135 NOK and the annual result was -245 263 NOK; operating income was up from 621 588 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 477 837 NOK in 2024 to -245 263 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 7 275 102 NOK in 2024 to 7 029 839 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-15 (registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
